005package org.wpilib.hardware.expansionhub;
006
007import static org.wpilib.units.Units.Amps;
008import static org.wpilib.units.Units.Volts;
009import static org.wpilib.util.ErrorMessages.requireNonNullParam;
010
011import org.wpilib.hardware.hal.util.AllocationException;
012import org.wpilib.hardware.motor.MotorController;
013import org.wpilib.networktables.BooleanPublisher;
014import org.wpilib.networktables.DoublePublisher;
015import org.wpilib.networktables.DoubleSubscriber;
016import org.wpilib.networktables.IntegerPublisher;
017import org.wpilib.networktables.NetworkTableInstance;
018import org.wpilib.networktables.PubSubOption;
019import org.wpilib.system.SystemServer;
020import org.wpilib.units.measure.Current;
021import org.wpilib.units.measure.Voltage;
022
023/** This class controls a specific motor and encoder hooked up to an ExpansionHub. */
024public class ExpansionHubMotor implements MotorController, AutoCloseable {
025  /** The direction to follow a leader motor in when using the follow method. */
026  public enum FollowDirection {
027    /** Follow the leader motor in the same direction. */
028    Aligned,
029    /** Follow the leader motor in the opposite direction. */
030    Opposed
031  }
032
033  private static final int PERCENTAGE_MODE = 0;
034  private static final int VOLTAGE_MODE = 1;
035  private static final int POSITION_MODE = 2;
036  private static final int VELOCITY_MODE = 3;
037  private static final int FOLLOWER_MODE = 4;
038
039  /** Neutral mode applied when the motor output is commanded to 0. */
040  public enum NeutralMode {
041    /** Allow the motor to coast when output is zero. */
042    COAST,
043    /** Actively brake the motor when output is zero. */
044    BRAKE
045  }
046
047  private ExpansionHub m_hub;
048  private final int m_channel;
049  private double m_throttle;
050  private boolean m_isInverted;
051
052  private final DoubleSubscriber m_encoderSubscriber;
053  private final DoubleSubscriber m_encoderVelocitySubscriber;
054  private final DoubleSubscriber m_currentSubscriber;
055
056  private final DoublePublisher m_setpointPublisher;
057  private final BooleanPublisher m_floatOn0Publisher;
058  private final BooleanPublisher m_enabledPublisher;
059
060  private final IntegerPublisher m_modePublisher;
061
062  private final BooleanPublisher m_reversedPublisher;
063  private final BooleanPublisher m_resetEncoderPublisher;
064
065  private final DoublePublisher m_distancePerCountPublisher;
066
067  private final ExpansionHubVelocityConstants m_velocityPidConstants;
068  private final ExpansionHubPositionConstants m_positionPidConstants;
069
070  /**
071   * Constructs a motor at the requested channel on a specific USB port.
072   *
073   * @param usbId The USB port ID the hub is connected to
074   * @param channel The motor channel
075   */
076  public ExpansionHubMotor(int usbId, int channel) {
077    m_hub = new ExpansionHub(usbId);
078    m_channel = channel;
079
080    if (!m_hub.checkMotorChannel(channel)) {
081      m_hub.close();
082      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Channel " + channel + " out of range");
083    }
084
085    if (!m_hub.checkAndReserveMotor(channel)) {
086      m_hub.close();
087      throw new AllocationException("ExpansionHub Motor already allocated");
088    }
089
090    m_hub.reportUsage("ExHubMotor", channel, "ExHubMotor");
091
092    NetworkTableInstance systemServer = SystemServer.getSystemServer();
093
094    PubSubOption[] options =
095        new PubSubOption[] {
096          PubSubOption.SEND_ALL, PubSubOption.KEEP_DUPLICATES, PubSubOption.periodic(0.005)
097        };
098
099    m_encoderSubscriber =
100        systemServer
101            .getDoubleTopic("/rhsp/" + usbId + "/motor" + channel + "/encoder")
102            .subscribe(0, options);
103    m_encoderVelocitySubscriber =
104        systemServer
105            .getDoubleTopic("/rhsp/" + usbId + "/motor" + channel + "/encoderVelocity")
106            .subscribe(0, options);
107    m_currentSubscriber =
108        systemServer
109            .getDoubleTopic("/rhsp/" + usbId + "/motor" + channel + "/current")
110            .subscribe(0, options);
111
112    m_setpointPublisher =
113        systemServer
114            .getDoubleTopic("/rhsp/" + usbId + "/motor" + channel + "/setpoint")
115            .publish(options);
116
117    m_distancePerCountPublisher =
118        systemServer
119            .getDoubleTopic("/rhsp/" + usbId + "/motor" + channel + "/distancePerCount")
120            .publish(options);
121
122    m_floatOn0Publisher =
123        systemServer
124            .getBooleanTopic("/rhsp/" + usbId + "/motor" + channel + "/floatOn0")
125            .publish(options);
126    m_enabledPublisher =
127        systemServer
128            .getBooleanTopic("/rhsp/" + usbId + "/motor" + channel + "/enabled")
129            .publish(options);
130
131    m_modePublisher =
132        systemServer
133            .getIntegerTopic("/rhsp/" + usbId + "/motor" + channel + "/mode")
134            .publish(options);
135
136    m_reversedPublisher =
137        systemServer
138            .getBooleanTopic("/rhsp/" + usbId + "/motor" + channel + "/reversed")
139            .publish(options);
140
141    m_resetEncoderPublisher =
142        systemServer
143            .getBooleanTopic("/rhsp/" + usbId + "/motor" + channel + "/resetEncoder")
144            .publish(options);
145
146    m_velocityPidConstants = new ExpansionHubVelocityConstants(usbId, channel);
147    m_positionPidConstants = new ExpansionHubPositionConstants(usbId, channel);
148  }
149
150  /** Closes a motor so another instance can be constructed. */
151  @Override
152  public void close() {
153    m_hub.unreserveMotor(m_channel);
154    m_hub.close();
155    m_hub = null;
156
157    m_encoderSubscriber.close();
158    m_encoderVelocitySubscriber.close();
159    m_currentSubscriber.close();
160    m_setpointPublisher.close();
161    m_floatOn0Publisher.close();
162    m_enabledPublisher.close();
163    m_modePublisher.close();
164    m_reversedPublisher.close();
165    m_resetEncoderPublisher.close();
166    m_distancePerCountPublisher.close();
167
168    m_velocityPidConstants.close();
169    m_positionPidConstants.close();
170  }
171
172  /**
173   * Sets the throttle.
174   *
175   * @param throttle The throttle where -1 represents full reverse and 1 represents full forward.
176   */
177  @Override
178  public void setThrottle(double throttle) {
179    m_throttle = throttle;
180    setEnabled(true);
181    m_modePublisher.set(PERCENTAGE_MODE);
182    m_setpointPublisher.set(throttle);
183  }
184
185  /**
186   * Gets the last commanded throttle, before inversion. Initially zero and reset to zero by {@link
187   * #unfollow()}. Commands in other control modes do not update this value.
188   *
189   * @return The commanded throttle where -1 represents full reverse and 1 represents full forward.
190   */
191  @Override
192  public double getThrottle() {
193    return m_throttle;
194  }
195
196  /**
197   * Sets the voltage to run the motor at. This value will be continuously scaled to match the input
198   * voltage.
199   *
200   * @param voltage The voltage to drive the motor at, in volts
201   */
202  @Override
203  public void setVoltage(double voltage) {
204    setEnabled(true);
205    m_modePublisher.set(VOLTAGE_MODE);
206    m_setpointPublisher.set(voltage);
207  }
208
209  /**
210   * Sets the voltage to run the motor at. This value will be continuously scaled to match the input
211   * voltage.
212   *
213   * @param voltage The voltage to drive the motor at
214   */
215  @Override
216  public void setVoltage(Voltage voltage) {
217    setVoltage(voltage.in(Volts));
218  }
219
220  /**
221   * Command the motor to drive to a specific position setpoint. This value will be scaled by
222   * setDistancePerCount and influenced by the PID constants.
223   *
224   * @param setpoint The position setpoint to drive the motor to
225   */
226  public void setPositionSetpoint(double setpoint) {
227    setEnabled(true);
228    m_modePublisher.set(POSITION_MODE);
229    m_setpointPublisher.set(setpoint);
230  }
231
232  /**
233   * Command the motor to drive to a specific velocity setpoint. This value will be scaled by
234   * setDistancePerCount and influenced by the PID constants.
235   *
236   * @param setpoint The velocity setpoint to drive the motor to
237   */
238  public void setVelocitySetpoint(double setpoint) {
239    setEnabled(true);
240    m_modePublisher.set(VELOCITY_MODE);
241    m_setpointPublisher.set(setpoint);
242  }
243
244  /**
245   * Sets if the motor output is enabled or not. Defaults to false.
246   *
247   * @param enabled True to enable, false to disable
248   */
249  public void setEnabled(boolean enabled) {
250    m_enabledPublisher.set(enabled);
251  }
252
253  /**
254   * Sets if the motor should brake or coast when 0 is commanded. Defaults to BRAKE mode.
255   *
256   * @param mode Neutral mode to apply when output is zero.
257   */
258  public void setNeutralMode(NeutralMode mode) {
259    requireNonNullParam(mode, "mode", "setNeutralMode");
260    m_floatOn0Publisher.set(mode == NeutralMode.COAST);
261  }
262
263  /**
264   * Gets the current being pulled by the motor.
265   *
266   * @return Motor current
267   */
268  public Current getCurrent() {
269    return Amps.of(m_currentSubscriber.get(0));
270  }
271
272  /**
273   * Sets the distance per count of the encoder. Used to scale encoder readings.
274   *
275   * @param perCount The distance moved per count of the encoder
276   */
277  public void setDistancePerCount(double perCount) {
278    m_distancePerCountPublisher.set(perCount);
279  }
280
281  /**
282   * Gets if the underlying ExpansionHub is connected.
283   *
284   * @return True if hub is connected, otherwise false
285   */
286  public boolean isHubConnected() {
287    return m_hub.isHubConnected();
288  }
289
290  /**
291   * Gets the current velocity of the motor encoder. Scaled into distancePerCount units.
292   *
293   * @return Encoder velocity
294   */
295  public double getEncoderVelocity() {
296    return m_encoderVelocitySubscriber.get(0);
297  }
298
299  /**
300   * Gets the current position of the motor encoder. Scaled into distancePerCount units.
301   *
302   * @return Encoder position
303   */
304  public double getEncoderPosition() {
305    return m_encoderSubscriber.get(0);
306  }
307
308  /**
309   * Sets if the motor and encoder should be reversed.
310   *
311   * @param reversed True to reverse the motor and encoder, false otherwise
312   */
313  public void setReversed(boolean reversed) {
314    setInverted(reversed);
315  }
316
317  /**
318   * Sets the inversion state of the motor and encoder.
319   *
320   * @param isInverted True to reverse the motor and encoder, false otherwise
321   */
322  @Override
323  public void setInverted(boolean isInverted) {
324    m_isInverted = isInverted;
325    m_reversedPublisher.set(isInverted);
326  }
327
328  /**
329   * Gets the inversion state of the motor and encoder.
330   *
331   * @return True if the motor and encoder are reversed, false otherwise
332   */
333  @Override
334  public boolean getInverted() {
335    return m_isInverted;
336  }
337
338  /** Reset the encoder count to 0. */
339  public void resetEncoder() {
340    m_resetEncoderPublisher.set(true);
341  }
342
343  /**
344   * Gets the motor constants object for velocity PID.
345   *
346   * @return Velocity motor constants object
347   */
348  public ExpansionHubVelocityConstants getVelocityConstants() {
349    return m_velocityPidConstants;
350  }
351
352  /**
353   * Gets the motor constants object for position PID.
354   *
355   * @return Position motor constants object
356   */
357  public ExpansionHubPositionConstants getPositionConstants() {
358    return m_positionPidConstants;
359  }
360
361  /**
362   * Sets this motor to follow another motor on the same hub.
363   *
364   * <p>This does not support following motors that are also followers. Additionally, the direction
365   * of both motors will be the same.
366   *
367   * @param leader The motor to follow
368   * @param direction The direction to follow the leader
369   */
370  public void follow(ExpansionHubMotor leader, FollowDirection direction) {
371    requireNonNullParam(leader, "leader", "follow");
372    if (leader.m_hub.getUsbId() != this.m_hub.getUsbId()) {
373      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Leader motor must be on the same hub as the follower");
374    }
375    if (leader.m_channel == this.m_channel) {
376      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cannot follow self");
377    }
378    m_hub.addFollower(leader.m_channel, this.m_channel);
379    setEnabled(true);
380    m_modePublisher.set(FOLLOWER_MODE);
381    if (direction == FollowDirection.Opposed) {
382      m_setpointPublisher.set(leader.m_channel + 4);
383    } else {
384      m_setpointPublisher.set(leader.m_channel);
385    }
386  }
387
388  /** Stops following the currently set leader motor. */
389  public void unfollow() {
390    m_hub.removeFollower(this.m_channel);
391    m_throttle = 0;
392    setEnabled(false);
393    m_modePublisher.set(PERCENTAGE_MODE);
394    m_setpointPublisher.set(0);
395  }
396}
